normative_extracts.quote: A long task is any task whose duration on the main thread exceeds 50 milliseconds.

browser_support.notes: INP became a Core Web Vital in March 2024; Long Animation Frames (LoAF) extends Long Tasks in Chromium.

pipeline_phases: Input Delay (Blocked by Active Long Task)
engine_internals.mechanism_summary: INP measures the full latency from user input to next frame presentation: Input Delay + Processing Duration + Presentation Delay, dominated by >50ms Long Tasks.

production_failures.symptom: INP P75 spikes above 450ms on product filter clicks
production_failures.root_cause: Synchronous React/DOM re-render of 2,000 list items blocks the main thread for 350ms, followed by a 100ms Layout/Paint pass.
production_failures.mitigation: Virtualize the list, defer non-urgent state updates, and yield before heavy post-click work.

production_failures.symptom: Input Delay alone exceeds 200ms despite tiny click handler
production_failures.root_cause: Third-party tag manager or hydration script runs a 250ms Long Task when the user taps before hydration finishes.
production_failures.mitigation: Break hydration into <50ms chunks with scheduler.yield() and audit Long Animation Frames (LoAF).
